title: Wanting a Wife Isn't the Sin
caption:
There's a difference between wanting a wife and organizing your whole life around finding one. One is a good desire. The other is a search engine you never turn off, and desperation has a smell. She can tell before you can.

The guy walking with God isn't pretending he doesn't want a wife. He's just not run by it anymore. Prayer comes before the app. Scripture before the scroll through her profile.

Here's the question that tells you the truth: would you still walk with God if she never came? If the honest answer is no, you were never chasing Him in the first place.

The man worth marrying is the one who wasn't chasing her to become one.

#faith #singleness #godsplan #christianmen #trustgodstiming
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
